fusions.name: Royal Edict
fusions.desc: Strikes the first enemy it meets for 30 damage. When it hits, allies strike 20% harder for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Proclamation
fusions.desc: Calls out in a cone 4 tiles long that deals 3 damage to everything in it, each with a 30% chance of [Damped] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Rallying Overflight
fusions.desc: Every ally within 6 tiles strikes 20% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Orderly Skies
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner. Your armour rises by 5%.
